top_signals.title: Weak China PMIs Spark Fresh Stimulus Bets
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Minmin Low breaks down why developments in China’s official manufacturing gauge are fueling expectations for another PBOC interest rate cut. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Stock Selloff Eases in Asian Trade, Crude Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A selloff in stocks eased during Asian trading on Monday as regional equities fell less than their Wall Street peers and US equity futures turned higher. Oil declined.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
